summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests an HPV L1 vaccine combined with imiquimod and metformin, given alongside standard chemoradiation, for HPV-associated cervical, vaginal, or vulvar cancer. The vaccine is injected into the tumor and under the skin, metformin tablets are taken twice daily for two weeks, and imiquimod cream is applied at home three nights per week, with visits during and after radiation. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; the study aims to see whether the combination helps the body fight the cancer and to record side effects.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa una vacuna contra el VPH con proteína L1, combinada con imiquimod y metformina, administrada junto con quimiorradiación estándar, para el cáncer de cuello uterino, vagina o vulva asociado al VPH. La vacuna se inyecta en el tumor y debajo de la piel, la metformina se toma en tabletas dos veces al día durante dos semanas, y la crema de imiquimod se aplica en casa tres noches por semana, con visitas durante y después de la radiación. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio busca saber si la combinación ayuda al cuerpo a combatir el cáncer y registrar los efectos secundarios.
who_for: Newly diagnosed cervical, vaginal, or vulvar carcinoma that is locally advanced or metastatic.
Not considered a primary surgical candidate, or responding after neoadjuvant therapy.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Aged 18 to 64 years with adequate organ function.
not_for: Untreated, new, or progressive brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.
Past allergic reaction to compounds similar to study agents.
Psychiatric or social situations that would limit compliance; pregnant or breastfeeding.
